title: Permutation polynomials from the trace functions
summary: We study necessary and sufficient conditions on $γ$ for several classes of polynomials of the form $X+γ\operatorname{Tr}_{q}^{q^n}(h(X))$ to be permutation polynomials over finite field $\mathbb{F}_{q^n}$, where $q$ is a prime power, $n$ is a positive integer, and $\operatorname{Tr}_{q}^{q^n}(\cdot)$ denotes the relative trace function from $\mathbb{F}_{q^n}$ to $\mathbb{F}_q$.
